videos.script: Lesson 2 described what a vision model does. This lesson calls one, through OpenAI's API. {{title}} The request is a chat message with a picture in it. Either a link to the picture, or the picture itself, encoded as text. {{request}} You pay for the picture in tokens, and there is a rule for how many. You will work it out for the cover, the invoice and a phone photo. {{tokens}} Then you will ask for the invoice back as data, in a shape your program declares. And you will check the numbers, because a valid shape is not a true answer. {{schema}} Two dangers come with every picture a customer sends. Text inside it can try to give the model orders. And the file can say where the customer lives. {{risks}} The model behind the API runs on your own computer. It is small, and it makes real mistakes. That is the point. {{end}}
